what: Voice matching thresholds, measured on LibriSpeech dev-clean-2 (26 speakers with 4+ utterances of 4 s or more, 307 utterances, first 10 s of each). Development data only; no audio is kept in the repository.
model: WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM, 256 numbers a voice (CC-BY-4.0, trained on VoxCeleb2 dev); features computed in numpy the way Kaldi does

conversations.what: 60 mixed conversations of 2-4 speakers, 6-9 turns of 3-7 s each; speech grouped by voiceprint.speakers_of with word times; share of words given the right speaker
conversations.shorter_stretches: 3 s stretches lifted rapid turn-taking to 0.88 but cut the right number of speakers from 0.95 to 0.58 (a voice split in two); 2 s stretches broke it (0.10). 6 s kept.

chosen.why: inside one file the cost of a mistake is a wrong label on some words, so 0.50 (99.4% of words right); across files a merge puts two people's edits together, so the line is 0.55 (1 in 1,100 different pairs) with an unsure band below it

limits: LibriSpeech is clean read speech. Phone audio, music under speech, laughter and overlapping talk are harder; speakers who answer within a breath of each other (no pause) are merged into one stretch and mislabelled, as the rapid-turn-taking numbers show. A speaker heard for under a second in total is not placed.
